_comment: Service split for the railway provider. rules are ordered regexes on the snake_case resource name (first match wins); overrides place a single resource. A resource that lands in 'misc' fails generation until a rule or override places it.

descriptions.account: The authenticated user: profile, API tokens and the workspaces a token can reach, sessions, passkeys, SSH keys, linked provider accounts and preferences.
descriptions.agents: Cloud agents, their tasks and checkpoints, and sandboxes with their sessions, checkpoints and template builds.
descriptions.billing: Usage and cost: aggregated and estimated usage by measurement, per-project and per-service usage, workspace totals, and the billing customer with its credits and usage limits.
descriptions.deployments: Deployments and their lifecycle (redeploy, restart, rollback, stop, cancel, remove), deployment events, instances, snapshots and deployment triggers.
descriptions.environments: Environments, staged changes and patches, change sets, environment history and pending work.
descriptions.integrations: Project integrations and linked accounts: GitHub repositories, branches and access, Heroku and Vercel imports.
descriptions.networking: Service domains, custom domains, TCP proxies, private networks, egress gateways, and Railway-registered domains with their DNS records and email forwarding rules.
descriptions.observability: Build, deployment, environment, HTTP, DNS query and network flow logs; resource and HTTP metrics; traces; observability dashboards; project events; notification rules and deliveries.
descriptions.platform: Platform reference data: regions, platform status, public statistics, function runtimes, platform feature flags and signals.
descriptions.projects: Projects and their lifecycle, members, invitations, invite codes, project tokens, permissions, canvas groups and compliance.
descriptions.services: Services, per-environment service instances (build and deploy configuration, redeploy), resource limits, auto deploy status and edge configuration.
descriptions.storage: Volumes, volume instances, backups and backup schedules, point-in-time recovery, and object storage buckets with their credentials.
descriptions.templates: Templates: search, details, services, metrics, deployment, publishing and workspace templates.
descriptions.variables: Service and shared environment variables: rendered values, variable metadata, upsert and delete.
descriptions.workspaces: Workspaces, members, access groups, identity providers, trusted domains, policies, audit logs and compliance agreements.
